note: Source of truth for card implementation status. build-coverage.cjs only adds skeletons / prunes dead ids; it never advances status or edits classification.

count-resource-icons.spec: NumberExpression { type:'resourceIcons', player, icon } = how many of a given resource icon a player controls in play (face-up resource icons + Volition for face-down). Also serves 'while you control at least [X][X]' threshold-style gates via numberCompare. High-frequency across every Seed-era set.

flip-up.spec: Alternate deploy path: a card may be played face-down as a resource now and later 'flipped up' by paying its FLIP UP cost (icons + sometimes an influence loss / bonus action). Needs (a) a play mode that pays an alternate Cost[] parsed from a 'FLIP UP: ...' clause, (b) a resolution-context flag deployedViaFlipUp readable by conditions/variables, (c) a face-down permanent that remembers its flip-up cost. Pervasive from Seed 2 on.

replacement-effect.spec: A 'if X would happen, instead Y' layer consulted BEFORE a mutation commits. New ability kind 'replacement' with an event-shaped match, an optional 'you may + cost' gate, and replacement effects. Deepest addition; several Seed 3 Uniques plus many later cards. [IMPLEMENTED: mandatory + optional forms, events moveToZone / destroy. replaces.controlledBy scopes on whose card is affected; replaces.by ('self'|'opponent'|'any') scopes on who initiated it ('by an opposing card or effect') incl. lethal battle damage. Damage-would-be-inflicted is not a replaceable event (no card needs it; damageModifiers cover amount tuning).]

damage-modifier.spec: Static/continuous 'when battle (or any) damage is inflicted to <selector>, increase/decrease the amount by N', applied during damage assignment. Distinct from replacement-effect (adjusts an amount, doesn't cancel). Shieldmane Grandchest; common in Seed 2.

continuous-aura.spec: A ContinuousAbility whose modifiers/keywords/restrictions apply to EVERY card matching a CardSelector (recomputed live), not a single TargetRef. Per-target values may derive from the target ('lose life equal to printed life minus 2'). Needed for team buffs/debuffs that aren't one-shot tactics.

cost-modifier.spec: Continuous 'a given player (self/opponents/all) must pay +N / pays -N (min M) to deploy cards matching <selector or named subtype>'. Feeds getCardPlayability/playCard cost math. Vilghame, Ensmallment Ray, Port Manteau; very common.

terminate-stack-item.spec: Effect { type:'terminate', target } that removes a still-unresolved card/ability from the response stack (a.k.a. 'counter'), sending a terminated card to its owner's discard without resolving. Also an 'all other unresolved cards' form. Great Wall, Anatidaephobia, Refrigerator Alarm.

activate-from-zone.spec: Allow an activated ability to declare an activation zone (discard / hand / void) and be usable from there (RECUR / EXHUMATION / RETIRE). The sourceInZone condition already exists; the activation path (getActivatableAbilities, cost payment, source lookup) assumes zone==='play'. Prestige Inversion, Spatchcocking; pervasive later.

mill.spec: Effect { type:'mill', player, count } = move the top `count` cards of a deck to its owner's discard. Ipsighast, Overzealous Excavation (Seed 2), many.

deck-position-ref.spec: Reference the top / bottom N cards of a deck: a TargetRef/selector form ({ type:'deckPosition', player, from:'top'|'bottom', count }) and a `position` option on moveCard's destination when to==='deck'. Axeclaw (cost of top card), Stone of Triumph (put on top), Geiseric / Cowslaw digging.

bind-variable.spec: Effect { type:'bind', id, value:NumberExpression } evaluates `value` immediately and stores it in ResolutionContext.variables[id] for later effects in the same ability — so a value captured from a card (its strength/life) survives that card leaving play mid-effect. Merbegon; Pony Slaystation could use it but doesn't need it.

name-a-value.spec: PendingChoice 'nameValue' (player names a card name or a subtype from a closed list) + a variable binding a string, referenced by conditions/cost-modifier selectors. Mirrors chooserSelectsOption's structured+label shape. Port Manteau.

token-permanents.spec: Create N token permanents in play not backed by a deck card (named 'Micromajig' etc., with printed stats / a definition supplied inline or by a synthetic CardDefinition). Cease to exist on leaving play. Refrigerator Alarm, Unscrupuls of Victory.

grant-ability-text.spec: A continuous effect that grants ability/keyword/Unique DATA (not printed English) to every card matching a selector, with values keyed off each card ('gains Unique X where X is its name'). God's Autograph. Rare, large; likely deferred past the pilot.

play-extra-cost-nontactic.spec: Honor a designated on-play ability's targets/costs/condition (the tactic 'first activated ability' convention in getPlayTargetDeclarations/getTacticCosts) for NON-tactic permanents too, so a character/item/location can carry 'EXTRA COST: pick 2 characters' + an ETB that uses them. Intriguing Mezzanine.

trade-condition.spec: Condition { type:'cardTradeIs', target, trade } (and/or a `trade` field on CardSelector) to match/exclude by trade — 'all non-Rogue characters'. Trivial. Delicious Strawberry Flavored Death.

printed-stat.spec: NumberExpression { type:'printedStat', target, stat } = a card's printed BASE stat before modifiers (parallel to cardCost). Fornicaves ('printed life minus 2').

combat-restrictions.spec: Extend Restriction with 'mustAttack' / 'mustBlock' (forced combat) and enforce in declareAttack/declareBlockers legality + a UI hint. 94r913 My 908570pp3r5.

has-unique-condition.spec: Condition / CardSelector predicate 'card has a Unique designation' (unique != null). Trivial once `unique` metadata is populated. Prestige Inversion.

nth-this-turn.spec: Per-turn counter so a trigger can fire only on the Nth matching event this turn ('the first resource each opponent plays each turn'). Needs a small serializable per-turn tally + an eventOrdinal condition. Vilghame Manewaft.

sacrifice-selected-cost.spec: Generalize depleteSelected into a cost that consumes already-selected cards by a given disposition (removeFromGame / destroy / moveCard) — 'remove X tactics in your discard pile from the game' as a cost. Cowslaw.

for-each-player.spec: Effect { type:'forEachPlayer', order, effects } running sub-effects once per player with `controller`/`owner` rebound to that player (turn order). Community Chest, Spatchcocking.

responding-to-condition.spec: Play-timing condition 'this is being deployed in response to a <cardType> being deployed' (inspects the response window's triggering stack item) + a TargetRef for that item so its cost can be referenced. Anatidaephobia.

meta-use-ability.spec: Effect that lets the controller activate one of a TARGET card's abilities as a sub-resolution, optionally doubling its effect. Notion Sickness. Rare, large; likely deferred past the pilot.

deploy-history.spec: Per-turn record of what each player deployed (by name) so a condition can ask 'did an opponent deploy >=2 cards with the same name this turn'. Refrigerator Alarm.

restore-restriction.spec: Tag on a card instance ('not restored by its controller's faction restore rule'), set by an effect/cost and consulted in applyFactionStartOfTurn. Intriguing Mezzanine.

damage-self-cost.spec: Cost { type:'dealDamage', target, amount } — pay by inflicting damage on a card you control (typically 'source'), used by locations that spend their own structure. Intriguing Mezzanine ('Inflict 1 damage to this location. If you do, ...').

replacement-effect-optional.spec: The optional/gated form of a replacement ability: "if X would happen, you MAY pay <cost> (and/or choose). If you do, <Y> instead; otherwise X happens." Needs a pause (PendingChoice) mid-replacement. Giada, Geiseric.

name-match-condition.spec: Condition comparing one card name to another (e.g. a deck card whose name equals the triggering event card) — "search your deck for a card with the same name". The Stone of Triumph.

optional-cost-in-effect.spec: "You may pay N. If you do, ..." as a step inside a triggered/replacement effect list — a payResources-carrying chooser branch or a dedicated payCost effect. The Stone of Triumph, and shared with replacement-effect-optional.

flip-face-down.spec: Effect { type:'flipFaceDown', target } — flip an in-play card (character/item/location/resource) face-down under its OWNER's control. Per RULES.md §2 (CR §411.3/§411.4) the flip is 'leaves play' + 'a brand-new card enters play': damage/tokens/attachments/temp text all cleared; the result is a face-down resource providing Volition. Also the tactic self-disposition form 'Put this card into play under its owner's control as a face-down resource instead of into their discard pile' — authored as the tactic's own effect { type:'flipFaceDown', target:'source' }; finishStackItem/finishFlipUp bookkeeping must detect the source already re-entered play and skip the move-to-discard. Pervasive from the FLIP UP era on (~28 Seed 2 cards).

self-disposition.spec: CardDefinition/behavior marker selfDisposition?: 'faceDownResource' | 'hand' — where a resolving tactic goes AFTER its effects instead of the discard pile ('Put this card into play under its owner's control as a face-down resource instead of into their discard pile'; Clam Hash: '...into its owner's hand instead...'). Consulted by the post-resolution bookkeeping (finishStackItem / finishFlipUp). Distinct from flip-face-down which is the general effect; this is the disposition-override for the tactic itself and interacts with 'if you deployed this using FLIP UP' riders.

put-into-play-from-zone.spec: Effect { type:'putIntoPlay', target, controller, faceDown? } — move a card from deck/discard/void INTO play as its real type, running entrance bookkeeping (cardEnteredPlay emit, attach-requirement check, attackEligibleTurn). faceDown:true => enters as a face-down resource (like playResourceCard faceDown but sourced from any zone). Covers 'put the card into play under your control' / '...as a face-down resource' (Overzealous Excavation RECUR, Miraculous Regeneration, Peculate, Rosy Palmer, Party Clowns, Contrabulous RUNE OF ACCELERATION, Gilded Yurt).

deploy-from-zone.spec: Generalise deployForFree to source zone 'play' (a face-down permanent/tactic) or 'discard': { type:'deployFromZone', chooser, declaration, free?, } — the chosen card is DEPLOYED (a tactic resolves; a permanent enters play) without paying its numeric cost; threshold and non-numeric extra costs still apply; resolves synchronously as a nested consequence. 'Reveal a face-down tactic you control. You may deploy the tactic.' (Manifest, Hidden Ruins, Accidental Invention, Burly Assailment); 'Pick a non-resource card in your discard pile. You may deploy the card.' (Dark Awakening).

facedown-selector.spec: CardSelector.faceDown?: boolean. When true, match face-down in-play cards by their REAL definition.type (today face-down cards are excluded from any type-matched selector, SpoilsEngine ~L2476). Enables 'a face-down tactic/item/location/character/resource you control' targets (Foment, Manifest, Hidden Ruins, Accidental Invention, Burly Assailment, Implosive Explosion) and conditions on 'while this card is a face-down resource' (Fired Hand, Vorpal Sword).

card-provides-icon.spec: (1) getThresholds must also count non-resource in-play cards whose definition provides resource icons — 'PROVIDES: [O]' on a character, and the Crest items — not just cards where isResource() is true. getResourceIcons already returns definition.resource.provides regardless of type; only the isResource gate in getThresholds excludes them. (2) New condition { type:'cardProvides', target, icon, min } true when getResourceIcons(target) has >= min of icon — used with cardEnteredPlay / resourcePlayed triggers + target:'eventCard' for 'When a card that provides at least [X] enters play under your control'. ~15 Seed 2 cards.

triggered-from-zone.spec: TriggeredAbility.triggerZone?: Zone (default "play") — the trigger is live while its source sits in that zone; findTriggers scans every card in every zone and matches card.zone against triggerZone ("discard" — Manifest / Hidden Ruins / Accidental Invention / Burly Assailment; "void" — I Drink Your Milkshake!; "deck" — Community Chest’s mulligan-draw clause). Parallel to ActivatedAbility.activationZone.

scheduled-effect.spec: Effect { type:'scheduleEffect', when:'startOfNextTurn' | 'endOfTurn', condition?, effects } — registers a one-shot delayed effect on a serializable GameState list, fired at that moment (with the source/controller context captured) then discarded. 'Put the character into the void. At the start of your next turn, if this card is in play, put the voided character into play under your control.' (Gilded Yurt); 'At the end of the turn, put a token on this card and an opponent takes control of it.' (Vast Mastabatorium); Contrabulous RUNE OF ACCELERATION.

cards-drawn-event.spec: GameEvent cardsDrawn { playerId, count } emitted after any draw resolves (draw effect, Develop draw, faction opening/again). 'When a player draws any number of cards, that player may add or remove a token from this card.' (Meat of the Mountain).

keyword-suppression.spec: ContinuousAbility.suppressKeywords?: KeywordGrantDefinition[] — while condition holds, target/selector cards LOSE the named keyword (hasKeyword returns false even if statically printed or otherwise granted). 'While there is a token on this card, it loses COVERT and gains 1 strength and 1 life.' (Nattering Stoopswaggler).

can-block-covert.spec: New Keyword 'canBlockCovert' — a character with it is a legal blocker against a Covert attacking party (declareBlockers Covert check in SpoilsEngine treats it like Covert for blocking eligibility only). 'While there is a token on this card, it ... can block COVERT parties.' (Recyclable Golem).

cannot-be-restored.spec: New Restriction 'cannotBeRestored' — honoured in applyFactionStartOfTurn and the restore effect (same effect as restoreLocked, but grantable as a continuous aura). 'Characters cannot attack or be restored.' (Framptle Tromwibbler — aura over all characters).

damage-prevention-shield.spec: Effect { type:'preventDamage', target, amount, mode:'reduce' | 'redirect', redirectTo? } + a serializable per-card runtime shield list consumed as damage is inflicted this turn, expiring end of turn. 'Reduce the next damage inflicted to the character this turn by 2.' (Tiny Shiny); 'The next X damage that would be inflicted to the first picked card this turn is inflicted to the second picked card instead.' (Delectable Boon). Distinct from ContinuousAbility.damageModifiers (needs a live in-play source) and the redirectDamage keyword (battle-only, all damage).

superlative-selector.spec: Condition { type:'isExtremum', target, metric:'cost' | Stat, direction:'min' | 'max', among: CardSelector } — true when no card matching `among` has a strictly lower/higher metric than `target`. Lets a target declaration express 'the character with the lowest numeric cost' (count 1 + this in selector.conditions; ties => the controller picks among the extrema). Verrucose Brains.

detach-effect.spec: Effect { type:'detach', target } — clears CardInstance.attachedTo (a resource stops being attached to a faction; an Attach-to-X item is left unattached and cleaned up by the state-based check). 'You may pick a resource attached to your faction. If you do, detach it from your faction.' (Braggadocian Aide).

remembered-target.spec: Effect { type:'rememberTarget', key, target } storing a CardInstanceId on CardInstance.linkedTargets[key] (cleared on leaving play) + TargetRef { type:'remembered', key } to read it back, and via targetExists a 'that card is still in play' gate. 'EXTRA COST: Pick a location you control. While the picked location is in play, this card cannot attack or block.' (Conscientious Objector — onPlay.targets remembers it, a continuous self-restriction gates on it).

variable-bounds.spec: ActivatedAbility.variableBounds?: Record<string, { min?: NumberExpression; max?: NumberExpression }> validated when the playCard/activateAbility action supplies variables[id] — a chosen number capped by something OTHER than affordability. 'Pick a number for X, where X is less than or equal to the number of [O] you control.' (Desolate).

mill-destination.spec: mill effect gains to?: 'discard' | 'removed' (default 'discard') — 'remove the top N cards of their deck from the game'. Hideous Hexapede of Horror (top 6, all players). (Single-card top-of-deck removal already works via moveCard + deckPosition.)

duplicate-stack-card.spec: Effect { type:'duplicate', target } — instantiate a transient copy of the targeted tactic/card on the response stack (same definitionId, owner = original owner, a fresh CardInstance in a 'deploying' zone), resolve its effects under the current controller, then the copy ceases to exist (like a token). 'Duplicate the tactic. Terminate the tactic.' (Muddle).

type-change-modifier.spec: setCardType effect + GameState.cardTypeGrants + getCardTypes/hasCardType. For `duration` ADDS `cardType` (CR §208.1 — the card keeps its printed type; the §208.3 example still calls it "an item" while it "becomes a character"). Everything keyed off type consults hasCardType (typed selectors match both types, lethal-damage / attach-to SBAs, battle legality + CR §208.4 mid-battle removal, cardTypeIs, start-of-turn damage-clear + attack eligibility). grantStats -> `set` modifiers, same duration. Losing character type forgets this-turn damage (CR §208.3). RULES.md §3.7. Contrabulous Fabtraption RUNE OF ANIMATION.

activate-while-facedown.spec: Allow an ActivatedAbility with activationZone covering 'play' AND a new condition { type:'sourceIsFaceDown' } to be used while source.faceDown && zone==='play' (bypass the 'a face-down card's abilities cannot be activated' assert for that ability only). 'Reveal this card' in the cost is cosmetic; the card stays face-down unless an effect flips it. 'PETTY VENGEANCE — COST: Use this only while this card is a face-down resource. Reveal this card. Pay 1. ...' (Fired Hand); Vorpal Sword SNICKER SNACK.

partition-and-pick.spec: `partitionAndPick` effect + `GameState.pendingPartition` state machine driven by `partitionCards` -> `pickPile` -> `takeFromPile` pending choices. Both players reveal top N, split into K non-empty piles, cross-pick one of the other's piles, higher total `cost` pile's owner may take `winnerTakes` card(s), rest shuffled back. RULES.md §12. Mustache Aficionado (MUSTACHE SHOWDOWN).

staple-selector.spec: CardSelector.staple?: boolean + condition { type:'isStaple', target } — match/require a card whose ResourceDefinition.staple is true. 'search your deck for a staple resource' (Dowsing Cleric); 'reveal the top card of your deck ... if it is a staple resource' (Prophetic Assistant).

respond-to-ability.spec: respondingTo condition gains a way to match 'an ability is the newest unresolved stack item' (e.g. respondsTo: 'ability'), and terminate scope:'target' can point at that ability's stack item. 'Deploy this only in response to an ability. Terminate the ability.' (Cock Block).

alternative-cost.spec: Cost { type:'oneOf', options: Cost[][] } — the activator chooses one payable branch (a chooserSelectsOption-style pause at activation, or auto when only one branch is payable). 'Pay 1 or destroy a Micromajig token you control.' (Time Traveler Tourist Trap, ENSNARE).

activation-limit-per-turn.spec: ActivatedAbility.usesPerTurn?: number — a per-turn cap on how many times this ability may be activated (serializable per-turn tally keyed by card+ability, reset each turn). 'Use this only 5 times each turn.' (Vast Mastabatorium, YOU KNOW YOU WANT TO...).

retarget-extra-cost.spec: `retargetExtraCost` effect + `respondedToPicked` condition. Rewrites the responded-to stack item's stored EXTRA-COST card pick (the single in-play card of `cardType` -> `to`) everywhere it appears under that item's `context.selected`, so it resolves against the new pick. RULES.md §7. Mistaken Identity.

temp-resource-icons.spec: Effect { type:'grantResourceIcons', player, icon, amount, duration } adding phantom resource icons to a player's count for the duration, read by getThresholds / the resourceIcons expression (a serializable runtime list, cleaned up like modifiers). 'This turn, you control an additional [E][E][E][E].' (31337!).

source-depleted-condition.spec: Condition { type:'cardDepleted', target } (default 'source') — true when target is depleted. 'At the end of your turn, if this card is depleted, inflict 1 damage to it.' (Dying Hero).

reveal-from-hand-alt-cost.spec: `CardDefinition.revealFromHand: { cost }` + a `revealFromHand` payload on the `chooseDevelop` `playResource` choice + a `costOverride` on `deployCard`. Reveal the card from hand instead of playing a resource and deploy it for the flat `cost` (threshold + EXTRA COSTs still apply), consuming the turn's develop resource play. RULES.md §6. Witty Worm.

card-type-equals-condition.spec: Condition { type:'cardTypeEquals', target, other } — true when target and other resolve to cards of the same type. 'You may pick a card of the same type as the discarded card.' (Perturb).

use-any-ability.spec: Effect { type:'useAnyAbility', chooser, selector? } — chooser picks any one activatable ability of a card matching selector (default: any card they control) and resolves it as a nested sub-resolution. Generalises useTargetAbility (which needs a fixed target). 'At the start of your turn, you may use an ability.' (The Poshernacle).

same-party-damage-modifier.spec: A selector/condition predicate 'in the same battle party as <source>' for ContinuousAbility.damageModifiers. 'When battle damage is inflicted to a character in a party with this card, reduce the amount by 1.' (Necromantic Healer).

name-selector.spec: `CardSelector.name` — exact printed-name match ('search your deck for a card named Elitism' / 'a card named Micromajig'). Distinct from the `cardNameEquals` condition (compares two cards, not a literal). Contrabulous Fabtraption RUNE OF ACCELERATION.

reveal-top-n-pool.spec: CardSelector.fromTop (restrict to cards within the top N of their owner deck) + lookAndReorder `to: "bottom"` (relocate the reordered top N to the deck bottom in the chosen order). Composes into "reveal the top N of a deck, pick some, the owner bottoms the rest in any order." RULES.md §12. Rosy Palmer, and Her Five Friends.

faction-abilities.spec: FactionDefinition.abilities (ActivatedAbility[] on a faction card, activated via activateAbility with the faction card's id, RULES.md §3.6) + ActivatedAbility.usableBy ('controller' | 'anyPlayer'). Open R&D / Imperial Army / Evil Alliance DRAW & RESOURCE; Knitting Coalition INFLATIONARY FORCES (anyPlayer); Society ENCYCLOPEDIC KNOWLEDGE.

faction-omnithreshold.spec: FactionDefinition.meetsAllThresholds — meetsThreshold short-circuits true. The Evil Alliance's OMNIPOTENCE.

faction-start-of-turn-effects.spec: FactionDefinition.turn.startOfTurnEffects (Effect[] run automatically at the start of the faction controller's turn, source = faction card) + reduceNextCost.cardType. Imperial Army's develop rule ('reduce the next character's cost by 2'); Society token accrual.

develop-uses-per-turn.spec: FactionDefinition.turn.develop.usesPerTurn (default 1). The Union of Unextraordinary Miners' 'OVERTIME' = 2. GameState.developsUsedThisTurn counts.

active-player-condition.spec: Condition { type:'isActivePlayer', player?:PlayerRef (default 'controller') } — true when the resolved player is GameState.activePlayerId. Gates 'use this only during your turn' activated abilities / 'deploy this only during your turn' tactics. Hassan-i HARASH, Banana Peel, Confrontational Conflagration, Words of Glory, Shriever Breeding Program, Study Disturbance.

battle-active-condition.spec: Condition { type:'battleActive' } — true while GameState.battle is set and not finished. Compose with `not` for 'deploy this only NOT during a battle'. Drill Instructor, Fanatical Shriever, Fistfight, Confrontational Conflagration, Words of Glory, Sneaker Attack! (needs it true).

controller-of-playerref.spec: PlayerRef { type:'controllerOf', target:TargetRef } — the current controller of a targeted card (parallel to the existing 'ownerOf'). 'That character's controller ...' / 'its controller must choose ...'. Contiguous Defalcating Machine, Audacious Appraisal, Contractual Execution, Underwhelming Performance, Thabbashite Warmonger, The Lugubrian Council.

card-subtype-condition.spec: Condition { type:'cardSubtypeIs', target:TargetRef, subtype:string } — true when target's CardDefinition.subtype includes `subtype`. For eventCard subtype checks a CardSelector can't reach ('when another "cicibeo"/"gear"/"horsemajig" card enters play', 'if the picked character is a "dragon"'). Cicibeo the Swift, Draconic Luteoderm Suit, Pwny Bomb, Confrontational Conflagration.

unique-designation-selector.spec: CardSelector.uniqueDesignation?: string | string[] (match CardDefinition.unique) + Condition { type:'uniqueIs', target, designations:string[] }. 'search for a UNIQUE JO', 'all UNIQUE EUSTACE gain +3/+3', 'a character you control with UNIQUE EUSTACE'. Shade of the Devoured Emperor, Siluriformes Flaxenscale, Testudine Autoframe, Draconic Luteoderm Suit, Golden Charm.

lose-influence-cost.spec: Cost { type:'loseInfluence', amount:NumberExpression, player?:PlayerRef (default 'controller') } — 'Your faction loses N influence' as an activated-ability / EXTRA cost (distinct from the modifyInfluence effect; must be payable = influence not driven below 0? per CR influence can't be paid you don't have — treat as always payable, clamp at 0). Discordant Cadencer, Eustace Padamose-Gristwalter, Thabbashite Armorer, Thabbashite Financier.

grant-provides.spec: Effect { type:'grantProvides', target:TargetRef, icon:ResourceIcon | { fromNamed:string }, amount:NumberExpression, duration:Duration } + GameState.provideGrants: RuntimeProvideGrant[] (cardId, icon, amount, duration, createdTurn), consulted by getResourceIcons (so getThresholds / cardProvides / resourceIcons all see it) and cleared like modifiers. Card-level, unlike the player-level grantResourceIcons — survives-scoped to the card, works on 'each face-down resource'. Anxious Imp, Discordant Cadencer, Elitistmajig, Goldmau Sacks Representative, Thabbashite Chemist.

name-resource-icon.spec: nameValue effect + PendingNameValueChoice gain valueKind 'resourceIcon' (name one of rage/greed/deception/elitism/obsession/volition). The stored string is read by grantProvides.icon.fromNamed / reduceThreshold.icon.fromNamed. Thabbashite Chemist, Clockman Skydocks.

reduce-threshold-requirement.spec: Effect { type:'reduceThreshold', player:PlayerRef, icon:ResourceIcon | { fromNamed:string }, amount:NumberExpression } + GameState.thresholdReductions (playerId, icon, amount, createdTurn), consumed by the next successful deploy this turn (like reduceNextCost), consulted in meetsThreshold. Clockman Skydocks BUSINESS DAY / OVERTIME.

in-play-since-turn-start-condition.spec: Condition { type:'inPlaySinceTurnStart', target?:TargetRef (default 'source') } — true when the card's attackEligibleTurn === GameState.turn (i.e. it has been in play under its controller since the start of this turn). 'Use this only if this card has been in play since the start of the turn.' Jo Ciendeilio's granted RESEARCH ability.

attack-limit-per-turn.spec: Restriction 'attackOncePerTurn' (granted statically via behavior or as a continuous aura) + GameState.attacksThisTurn: Record<CardInstanceId, number>, incremented in declareAttack, reset each turn; declareAttack rejects a character that already attacked this turn while it has the restriction. 'This card can attack only once each turn' / 'Characters you control can attack only once each turn.' Pinguid Bodyguard, Skullcrush Steamroller, Torchlight District.

restore-at-end-of-battle.spec: scheduleEffect gains when:'endOfBattle' — fired as the current battle ends (battleEnded), then discarded. Lets 'when this attacks, restore it at the end of the battle' be a characterAttacked trigger that schedules a `restore` of the event card. Pinguid Bodyguard, Torchlight District; Barracks of Precipitancy (partial).

add-to-battle.spec: Effect { type:'addToBattle', target:TargetRef, side:'attacking' | 'blocking' | 'choose' } — insert an in-play character into the current battle's attacking/blocking party (inverse of removeFromBattle). 'choose' pauses on a chooserSelectsOption. No-op with no active battle. Does not deplete / re-check AGGRO (it's being added by an effect). Carnival Ringmaster, Sneaker Attack!.

lose-rules-text.spec: ContinuousAbility.suppressAllAbilities?: { target?:TargetRef; selector?:CardSelector } — while `condition` holds, the target/selector cards lose every OTHER ability (activated / triggered / continuous / replacement / granted), keeping only THIS ability. hasAbility / getActivatableAbilities / findTriggers / continuous recompute all skip a suppressed card's other abilities. Monstrous Lassitude, Rushing Crushing Blockhead, Mittens of Muffled Thought.

untargetable.spec: Restriction 'cannotBePicked' (continuous / conditional) — a card with it is removed from the candidate list of any player-or-chooser TARGET declaration (validateTargetDeclarations / autoSelectTargets / findUnresolvedTargetDeclarations / selectTargets pending choice / chooserSelectsTarget), but NOT from forEach / count / aura selectors. Optional scope { by?: 'nonItemSource' } for 'cannot be picked by non-item cards or abilities' (checks the resolving source's card type) — deferred if only Gigantitect needs it. Gigantitect's Giant Giant, Martial Arts Wannabe (conditional), Gloamspike-Gosche Bridge, Parkour Hoodlum (by locations — deferred scope).

remove-card-type.spec: Effect { type:'removeCardType', target:TargetRef, cardType:CardType } — clears a cardType previously ADDED by setCardType (removes matching GameState.cardTypeGrants entries for that card). No-op on the printed type. 'If this card is a character, it loses the "character" type.' Frickin' Sweet Pogo-Bunny.

player-play-restriction.spec: Effect { type:'restrictPlay', player:PlayerRef, kind:'cardType' | 'flipUp' | 'response', cardType?:CardType, duration:Duration } + GameState.playRestrictions[]. assertCanDeployAtCurrentTiming / the flipUp action / the response-window opener consult it. 'That player cannot play characters this turn', '... may not play cards using FLIP UP', 'Your opponents cannot respond to this card' (response -> a stack-item flag, see cannot-be-responded-to). Study Disturbance, Surreptitious Larceny, Swindle.

sum-stat-expression.spec: NumberExpression { type:'sumStat', selector:CardSelector, stat:Stat } — sum of `stat` (live value) over every card matching selector. 'X is the total strength of all characters your opponents control.' Words of Glory.

event-damage-amount-expression.spec: NumberExpression { type:'eventDamageAmount' } — the damage amount of the current `damageDealt` triggering event (0 outside one). 'put the top X cards ... where X is the amount of damage inflicted by this character.' Totally Random Kid.

event-damage-source-targetref.spec: TargetRef { type:'damageSource' } — the source card of the current `damageDealt` event (event.sourceId), parallel to 'eventCard' resolving to its target. 'X is the number of threshold icons of the character [that dealt the damage]'. Thabbashite Warmonger.

threshold-icon-count-expression.spec: NumberExpression { type:'thresholdIconCount', target:TargetRef } — the number of icons in a card's printed threshold (length of the normalized threshold string / sum of a numeric threshold). 'X is the number of threshold icons of the character.' Thabbashite Warmonger.

counter-threshold-trigger.spec: TriggeredAbility event 'counterChanged' (emitted by addCounter/removeCounter with { cardId, counter }) + condition counterCompare on source, so 'when there are at least/no tokens on this card, ...' fires immediately. Alternatively a state-based check. Flaming Cube, Runic Map ('when there are no tokens, destroy it').

chooser-nominates-number.spec: Effect { type:'chooserSelectsNumber', chooser:PlayerRef, storeAs:string, min?:NumberExpression, max?:NumberExpression, effects:Effect[] } — pauses for `chooser` (not the acting player) to pick an integer, bound into context.variables[storeAs] for `effects`. 'That character's controller chooses a number for X.' Audacious Appraisal.

damage-history-this-turn.spec: GameState.damageThisTurn: per-card record { assignedDamage:boolean; toFactionOf:PlayerId[] } populated on damageDealt, reset each turn. Conditions { type:'assignedDamageThisTurn', target? } and { type:'inflictedDamageToFactionThisTurn', player:PlayerRef, target? }. Backdoor Brigand ('has not assigned damage this turn'), Drive By Boobing ('a character that inflicted damage to your faction this turn').

modal-card.spec: CardDefinition.behavior.modes?: Array<{ label?; condition?; costs?; targets?; effects?; onPlay?: same shape }> — 'Choose one of the following as this card's rules text'. The controller picks a mode at play time (a `mode` field on the playCard action, or a pre-play PendingChoice) BEFORE the chosen mode's EXTRA COST / targets / condition are evaluated; only that mode's effects resolve. Distinct from chooserSelectsOption (which needs shared cost/targets). Expedition Endeavour, Shriever Breeding Program, Surreptitious Larceny.

temp-numeric-cost-modifier.spec: Effect { type:'modifyNumericCost', target:TargetRef, delta:NumberExpression, duration:Duration } + GameState.numericCostModifiers (per card), consulted wherever a card's numeric cost is read (getCardPlayability, deployCard, cardCost expression? — no, printed only). 'This turn, the character loses/gains 1 numeric cost.' Guileful Astucion.

play-resource-as-player.spec: playResource effect gains player?:PlayerRef (default context.controllerId) so 'that player puts a card from their hand face-down as a resource under their control' resolves under the right player. Man Shark, Forgotten Tentacle.

borrowed-until-end-of-turn.spec: putIntoPlay gains borrowed?:boolean — the card is removed from the game if it would leave play OR at end of turn (whichever first), via a scoped replacement + endOfTurn scheduled effect on that instance. 'put that card into play ... If that character would leave play or is in play at the end of the turn, remove it from the game instead.' Barracks of Precipitancy.

damage-modifier-by-source.spec: DamageModifierDefinition gains sourceSelector?:CardSelector matching the damage DEALER (not just the target). 'All damage assigned to this card by characters with items attached to them is reduced to 0.' Enlightened Mau.

outgoing-damage-modifier.spec: Effect { type:'modifyOutgoingDamage', source:TargetRef, delta:NumberExpression, duration:Duration } — a runtime list keyed on the damage SOURCE that tunes damage it deals this turn (floored at 0). 'This turn, if damage is inflicted to a character or faction by this card, reduce the amount by 1.' Sockem Bot (usableBy anyPlayer).

skip-restore-rule.spec: Effect { type:'skipRestoreRule', player:PlayerRef, turns?:number (default 1) } — the player's faction Restore Rule is skipped on their next N turns (a per-player counter consulted in applyFactionStartOfTurn). 'On your next turn, skip your faction's RESTORE RULE.' Monstrous Lassitude.

skip-next-restore.spec: Effect { type:'skipNextRestore', target:TargetRef } — a one-shot flag on a card so its controller's NEXT faction Restore Rule skips it once (then clears), unlike setRestoreLock which persists while in play. 'that character does not restore during its controller's next RESTORE RULE.' Numba 1 Stunna!.

cannot-take-control.spec: Restriction / continuous flag 'cannotBeTakenControl' — the takeControl effect skips a card that has it (relative to who's taking control — 'Opponents cannot take control of this card'). Gigantitect's Giant Giant.

continuous-from-hand.spec: ContinuousAbility.activeZone?: Zone (default 'play') — the ability is live while its source sits in that zone (parallel to TriggeredAbility.triggerZone). 'While this card is in your hand and there is a location in play, this card gains tactical.' Parkour Hoodlum.

dynamic-tactical-honored.spec: assertCanDeployAtCurrentTiming's TACTICAL check must consult hasKeyword (dynamic grants) not just definitionHasKeyword, so a granted/aura TACTICAL lets a card be deployed in a response window. Needs a CardInstanceId in scope at that call site. Gloamspike-Gosche Bridge (aura over hand), Parkour Hoodlum.

aura-over-hand-zone.spec: A ContinuousAbility aura (keywords/modifiers) whose selector names zone:'hand' must actually be evaluated for cards in hand — today auras are recomputed only over in-play cards. 'All characters in your hand gain TACTICAL.' Gloamspike-Gosche Bridge.

any-player-may-pay.spec: Effect { type:'anyPlayerMayPay', costs:Cost[], effects:Effect[], order?:'activeFirst' } — offer an optional paid effect to each player in turn until one accepts (or all decline). 'any player may pay 4 to put that card on top of its owner's deck.' Recycling Scheme Facility.

granted-activated-ability.spec: Wire ContinuousAbility.grantedAbilities ACTIVATED bodies: getActivatableAbilities / activateAbility resolve an ability granted to an in-play card by a selector, with source = the recipient. (Triggered granted bodies already work.) Jo Ciendeilio, M07h3r 0f 1337.

create-token-then-effect.spec: createTokens gains effects?:Effect[] resolved once per created token with it bound to { type:'selected', id:'__candidate' } — e.g. shield the just-made token ('all damage inflicted to that token is reduced to 0 this turn'). Micromajigmakermachinemajig, Micromajig Recycling Station (Micromajig damage immunity).

triggered-variable-prompt.spec: TriggeredAbility.variablePrompt?: { id:string; min?:NumberExpression; max?:NumberExpression } — a triggered ability that first pauses for its controller to pick a number (bound to context.variables[id]) before targets/effects, so a trigger can do 'choose a number for X and destroy X tokens'. Micromajig Recycling Station. [IMPLEMENTED as a composition: put a chooserSelectsNumber effect first in the trigger, with the number-dependent targets/costs/effects nested inside its  — no dedicated trigger-prompt field needed.]

reveal-from-hand-rider.spec: CardDefinition.revealFromHand gains threshold?:string|number and effects?:Effect[] (a rider: 'your faction loses 2 influence', extra icon gate). 'FINE PRINT: [G][G][G][G] EXTRA COST: Reveal this card from your hand. Your faction loses 2 influence. Pay 2. EFFECT: Draw a card.' Unexpected Codicil.

cannot-be-responded-to.spec: A flag on the StackItem (set by a tactic's EXTRA COST clause) that suppresses the opponent's response window for that item — it resolves without giving priority. 'Your opponents cannot respond to this card.' Swindle.

onplay-cost-adjust.spec: behavior.onPlay gains costAdjust?:NumberExpression evaluated in the play context and added (usually negative) to the numeric cost actually paid, floored at 0 — 'reduce this card's numeric cost by the number of cards removed [as an extra cost].' Opportunistic Pirate.

attacker-blocked-trigger.spec: An event / condition for 'when this attacking character becomes blocked' (declareBlockers, mapped to the attacker whose block was declared) — characterBlocked currently maps only to the blocker. 'When this card is blocked by an opposing party of 2 or more characters ...' Timid Mau.

ward-redirect.spec: An EXTRA-COST pick + a continuous, unbounded redirect: while both the picked card and this card are in play, (a) damage that would be dealt to the picked card is dealt to this card instead, and (b) if the picked card would leave play by any means, THIS card leaves play in that way instead. Distinct from preventDamage (bounded/self), the redirectDamage keyword (battle-only), and setCardType. Needs ContinuousAbility.damageRedirects?: [{ from, to }] hooked in dealDamage AND a replacement that mirrors any leave-play of `from` onto `to`. 6r4wny 60dy9u4rd5.

deploy-from-zone-conditional-free.spec: deployFromZone/deployForFree gain free?:'always'|'never'|Condition — deploy the revealed card paying its own numeric cost unless the condition holds (then waive it). 'You may deploy it even if you cannot meet its threshold. If its numeric cost is 4 or less, you may deploy it for free.' Gang Weapon Dealer.

repeat-until-decline.spec: Effect { type:'alternatingPayLoop', players:[PlayerRef,PlayerRef], cost:Cost[], onEnd:Effect[] } — alternately offer each player the cost; each acceptance tallies (context.variables 'paidBy<player>'); stop at the first decline; then run onEnd (which reads the tallies). 'You may pay 1. If you do, that opponent may pay 1. Repeat until someone doesn't. Each player draws cards equal to the amount they paid.' Negotiation Ceremonies.

card-ignores-source-class.spec: ContinuousAbility.ignoresRulesTextFrom?: CardType. While the source is in play (and condition holds) it cannot be PICKED as a target by a card of that type (targetCandidates filter, scoped on the resolving source's card type), and a single-target mutating effect (SOURCE_CLASS_GUARDED_EFFECTS) or a continuous aura whose origin is a card of that type is a no-op against it. Aggregate all-X / count effects still see it. 'This card ignores all rules text on locations' — Parkour Hoodlum. Not modelled: cost / damage-amount modifiers from an ignored source (edge).

cross-faction-rule-override.spec: FactionDefinition.overridesOpponent?: { startingDraw?: boolean; suppressDevelop?: boolean } — while this faction card is in play it rewrites sub-rules of the OPPONENT's faction. startingDraw: the opponent's opening hand uses THIS faction's setup.openingHand (createTwoPlayerFactionGame). suppressDevelop: getDevelopChoices returns [] for the opponent. The Knitting Coalition — HIDDEN INFLUENCE / PULLING STRINGS. 2-player only.

mixed-starting-resources.spec: FactionDefinition.setup.startingResources gains: slots (per-slot program — a resource slot places a face-up resource, an anyCard slot places any card, face-down if it is not a resource; The Society of Magical Propriety), chosenStaples ({ min, max, plus? } — X staples chosen at setup via FactionGameSetupOptions.startingResourceX, clamped to [min, max], default min, plus fixed extras; The Union of Unextraordinary Miners MONEY FOR NOTHING), matchOpponentCount (top the OPPONENT up with staples to equal this faction's starting-resource count). Cards drawn in deck order like the flat form; player does not choose which staple / card.

opponent-may-pay-to-counter.spec: Modelled with the existing mayPay effect: the tactic's real body is elseEffects, the buyout is effects (a peek — empty for Study Disturbance, lookAndReorder for Tedious TriAdic Truculence). Engine fixes: (1) mayPay now charges the RESOLVED effect.player's resources ('that player may pay 2', 'any opponent may pay 3'), mirroring anyPlayerMayPay; (2) lookAndReorder gains chooser?: PlayerRef so 'any opponent looks at the top 3 cards of YOUR deck and reorders them' works. CONCESSION: the buyout is offered on resolution (after a response window), not truly pre-stack; immaterial for these two cards.

develop-draw-replacement.spec: CardDefinition.behavior.developDrawReplacement?: { cost?: Cost[]; effects: Effect[] } — while the developing player controls an in-play card carrying it, choosing the draw develop option runs a mayPay (player = developer, costs = cost, effects = replacement.effects, elseEffects = the draw) instead of drawing. 'If you would draw a card as part of your Develop Rule, you may put a card voided by this card into its owner's hand instead' — Arcane Escrow (modelled as 'a card in your void'; void-origin not tracked).

deck-search-trigger.spec: New GameEvent deckSearched { playerId } — emitted when a chooserSelectsTarget effect raises a pick whose declaration selector names the deck zone (playerId = the deck owner). The pick is already the outstanding choice, so processImmediateQueue defers the trigger; it resolves right after the search completes. Golden Charm — 'If a player would search their deck you may pay 1 ... draw a card' (net: the interceptor may pay 1 to draw 1; the search proceeds). Scope: only chooserSelectsTarget-based deck picks emit it.

double-sided-faction.summary: EPIC faction cards have two sides and flip between them mid-game.
double-sided-faction.clause: INTERNAL CONFLICT / CONSTANT IN-FIGHTING — "At the end of your turn, flip a coin. If you win, turn this card over. (Only the face-up side is active.)"
double-sided-faction.needs: A double-sided CardDefinition model + an engine action that swaps the in-play faction card's active FactionDefinition to its reverse. Touches setup, getFactionDefinition, and every restore/develop/threshold path.

showdown-multiplayer.summary: The multiplayer "Showdown" format — 1 Villain vs. N Heroes, shared Temptation Pile, a separate Hero deck, Allegiance cards, and faction values that scale with X = the number of opponents.
showdown-multiplayer.clause: The Evil Alliance / Slightly Less Evil Alliance — ENTICEMENT, DARING GAMBIT, GIVE IN TO TEMPTATION, SPRING FORTH MY BURLY PROTECTOR!, YOUR TRUE COLORS ARE REVEALED, and "INFLUENCE = 15 + 10*X" / "repeat X-1 times".
showdown-multiplayer.needs: N-player game state, a Temptation Pile + Hero-deck zone, Allegiance-card tracking, and X-scaled faction values. The engine is 2-player only; this is a different game mode. In 2-player these clauses collapse to X = 1 (already handled) or are inert.
